description: This file defines a PHP class 'Properties' within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages document metadata such as creator, title, description, dates, custom properties, and related attributes, providing getter and setter methods for each. The class also includes logic for handling different property types and converting property values appropriately.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Represents document properties such as metadata (creator, title, description, dates, custom properties) in the PhpSpreadsheet library, with methods for managing and converting property data.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the creator of the document.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator of the document.

methods.name: getLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Returns the name of the last person who modified the document.

methods.name: setLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Sets the name of the last person who modified the document.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the document was created.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the document.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the document.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the document.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the document.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the document.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the document.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the document.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Returns the keywords associated with the document.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords for the document.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the document.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the category of the document.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company associated with the document.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company associated with the document.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the manager associated with the document.

methods.name: setManager
methods.description: Sets the manager of the document.

methods.name: getCustomProperties
methods.description: Returns a list of custom property names.

methods.name: isCustomPropertySet
methods.description: Checks if a custom property with the given name is set.

methods.name: getCustomPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified custom property.

methods.name: getCustomPropertyType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of a specified custom property.

methods.name: setCustomProperty
methods.description: Sets a custom property with value and type.

methods.name: convertProperty
methods.description: Converts a property value to a format suitable for Excel based on type.

methods.name: convertPropertyType
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a property type to its constant.

methods.name: getHyperlinkBase
methods.description: Returns the hyperlink base string.

methods.name: setHyperlinkBase
methods.description: Sets the hyperlink base string.
